public_rationale: On the ordinary reading that substantial outside demand was absent or not emerging, Jane Street’s disclosed AI cloud commitment is a counterexample. It names a customer outside both labs and a concrete commercial purchase commitment. This does not refute Zitron’s separate concern that aggregate demand may be inadequate for the construction pipeline. The result depends on distinguishing those two propositions.
limitations: The undefined phrase at scale materially affects the result.
A commitment demonstrates emerging demand, not realized consumption, profitability or eventual payment.

our_interpretation: The plain reading is that commercially substantial AI compute demand is absent outside the two named companies. Large, identified customer commitments can demonstrate emerging demand, although they do not establish realized consumption.
Use April–June 2026, the latest completed reporting quarter before publication, for the ongoing state described.
The surrounding argument also concerns demand sufficient to absorb the entire construction pipeline. That stronger sufficiency test is distinct from whether substantial outside demand exists.

criteria.contradiction_condition: An identified customer outside those companies demonstrates commercially substantial AI compute demand through actual purchases or a concrete large commitment during the target period.
